exact_object: Clause-falsifying affine subspaces in GF(2)^d after x = p + B lambda
admission_condition: Every pair of nonempty forbidden subspaces is disjoint or nested
constructive_theorem: Laminar affine forbidden-subspace arrangements are decidable in polynomial total work by Gaussian-elimination recognition, maximal-subspace compression, exact disjoint union counting, conditional-counting SAT witness recovery, and disjoint-cover UNSAT certification.
claim_boundary: Laminar arrangements only. Crossing arrangements, arbitrary 3-CNF, unrestricted Horn-affine composition, and P versus NP remain open.
